svg.title: A real API call, X-rayed against the six layers
svg.desc: A hand-drawn JSON request body in Anthropic Messages shape sits on the left, with dashed leader lines running to six labelled cards on the right. The system field is layer 01, the tools array is layer 02, and layers 03 to 06 are all entries in the messages array: memory arrives as a synthetic user and assistant pair, retrieval as an evidence block on the user side, then the prior turns of the session, and finally the current user message placed last. Captions note that layers 01 and 02 are identical on every call and therefore cache, that 03 and 04 are assembled fresh and are the biggest cost lever, and that history grows without bound while the user turn stays small.
svg.text: A real API call, X-rayed against the six layers
Anthropic Messages shape. Field names differ across providers; the layers do not.
the prior turns of this session
The stable prefix (01–02) is identical on every call, so it caches.
Per-turn injection (03–04) is assembled fresh: the biggest cost lever.
History (05) grows monotonically; the user turn (06) is small but last.
